title: Look from above
hook: A color can be useful in one viewing direction.

doesNotKnow: A fish has a dark back and a pale belly. In this simple scene, which surface faces a predator looking down from above?

misconception: The first explanation of an aquatic animal feature must be correct.
objective: A fish has a dark back and a pale belly. In this simple scene, which surface faces a predator looking down from above?

claims.text: A fish has a dark back and a pale belly. In this simple scene, which surface faces a predator looking down from above? The above view presents the dark back against darker water. From below, the pale belly faces brighter surface light. This common form of countershading can reduce contrast, but actual visibility depends on lighting, water and the observer.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: NOAA Fisheries, fish anatomy and behavior, https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/

claims.text: The two panels are simplified schematics, not observations or measurements.
A fish has a pale belly. Which observer is likely to see that surface directly? A fish’s belly faces downward, so a viewer below can see it.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: NOAA Fisheries, fish anatomy and behavior, https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/

recall.question: A fish has a pale belly. Which observer is likely to see that surface directly?
options: An observer directly above the fish
recall.why: A fish’s belly faces downward, so a viewer below can see it.
